AyudaGrow / ExplorePrivacy & data protection

Privacy notice.
Draft for review.

This draft is for the planned contact-only website launch. It is not an effective production privacy notice. The actual data practices still need to be confirmed.

Who operates AyudaGrow.

Ayuda Grow LLC, registered in Florida, operates AyudaGrow.

Business address: 7901 Fourth Street North, St. Petersburg, Florida.

Contacting AyudaGrow.

The contact page links to admin@ayudagrow.com and +1 876-480-0413. These links open your email or phone application. The website does not submit an enquiry form or make a booking.

Emails sent to admin@ayudagrow.com go to AyudaGrow’s admin email inbox for the team to handle.

If you contact AyudaGrow, you choose what information to share. An enquiry may contain your name, contact details, business information and the contents of your message. Please share only what is needed and do not send passwords, payment-card details or sensitive customer records.

What this website currently includes.

This private candidate has no connected enquiry form, chatbot, payment checkout or analytics tag. The hosted preview is protected by the hosting service. These facts describe this version, not every system used by AyudaGrow.

A chatbot, GoHighLevel form or analytics service may be added later. Their data use, providers and any appropriate notices or consent choices need to be reviewed before they are enabled.

Hosting and communication services.

The absence of a website form does not mean that no personal information is processed. Visiting a hosted website or contacting a business can involve technical connection information and communications handled by service providers. The final notice must identify the actual production providers, purposes, security and storage arrangements.

Before this notice is published.

  • Confirm the designated privacy contact.
  • Confirm any further use, storage or sharing of enquiries, including any marketing use, and the applicable lawful grounds.
  • Identify the hosting, email, phone and any other providers used for the first release, including relevant international processing.
  • Confirm retention periods or criteria, deletion practices and how privacy requests are handled.
  • Confirm actual cookies, logs, analytics and security practices rather than assuming them.
  • Set out the rights and complaint routes that apply to the business and its visitors.
  • Add an effective date only after the final notice has been reviewed against the live configuration.

Questions about this draft can be sent to admin@ayudagrow.com. No retention period, security guarantee, legal jurisdiction or statutory response deadline has been assumed here.
